case: Human says success, provider says failure

fact_source.outranks_because: the provider decides the fact; a person may only add caution or open a dispute

head_behaviour: No human channel is read: the URF approval flags (user_confirmed, approved, owner_approved) have no writer in runtime/ or gateway/, and the operator-stated chat context admits five keys (wallet_connected, network, balance, jurisdiction, total_transactions), none of them an approval or a confirmation.
